names.legendary: The Calendar Who Cancelled Monday

lore.common: Stays on last month's page until someone notices in the middle of the next one.
lore.uncommon: Has a little ring drawn round every birthday, so nobody can pretend they forgot.
lore.rare: Shuffles its own dates, so the dentist appointment keeps landing on the trip to the zoo.
lore.epic: Double-booked the whole family for one Saturday, and they went to a wedding, a football match and a party in the same clothes.
lore.legendary: Crossed out Monday so firmly that the whole office took the day off, and nobody has worked out how to undo it.

names.legendary: The Page That Made It Friday

lore.common: Gets torn off a day early by someone who can't wait for the weekend.
lore.uncommon: Curls up at the corner like a little dog's ear.
lore.rare: Tears itself off at midnight, so everyone wakes up a day ahead.
lore.epic: Was torn off so fast before the holiday that the whole office snowed with paper days.
lore.legendary: Tore itself off five times in one night, and the whole school arrived for the summer holidays on a Tuesday in spring.

names.legendary: Sir Clipsworth the Self-Appointed

lore.common: Snaps its clip on your fingers every time you add a new sheet.
lore.uncommon: Has a list with little ticks on it that never quite gets finished.
lore.rare: Makes whoever holds it look so important that doors open and nobody asks questions.
lore.epic: Was carried round the school by a pupil for one afternoon, and three teachers tidied their desks just in case.
lore.legendary: Walked a lost tourist into the town hall meeting, and the tourist ended up chairing it.

names.legendary: Dearest Confida, Keeper of Crushes

lore.common: Has a little lock that pops open if you just look at it hard enough.
lore.uncommon: Has a tiny key that vanishes the night you most need it.
lore.rare: Falls open at the most embarrassing page whenever a brother walks past.
lore.epic: Was read aloud at the sleepover by mistake, and five friendships were fixed by morning.
lore.legendary: Kept a secret for forty years, then was found by a granddaughter who wrote the next page.

names.legendary: The Folder Nobody Could Find

lore.common: Sheds a sheet of paper every time it's lifted.
lore.uncommon: Has a label on its tab that doesn't match what's inside.
lore.rare: Hides important papers in the wrong drawer and then looks innocent.
lore.epic: Was pulled from the bottom of the stack, and the whole filing cabinet fell over like a waterfall of paper.
lore.legendary: Hid the same lost form for ten years, then turned up the day after it was no longer needed.

names.legendary: The Fattest Folder in Year Six

lore.common: Snaps its elastic band on your thumb when you close it.
lore.uncommon: Bulges with so many worksheets that it won't close properly.
lore.rare: Swallows the homework you need and spits out the one from last term.
lore.epic: Burst open on the bus, and every worksheet from the whole year flew out of the window.
lore.legendary: Held every worksheet from one whole school year and was entered into the school museum.

names.legendary: The Journal That Found the Waterfall

lore.common: Gets doodles in every margin before a single real word is written.
lore.uncommon: Has a soft leather cover that gets nicer every time it's held.
lore.rare: Wrote down an idea at midnight that its owner didn't remember having.
lore.epic: Was left open in the rain, and every page became a watercolour painting.
lore.legendary: Held the notes of an explorer who found a hidden waterfall, with the map drawn on page four.

names.legendary: The Notebook That Passed Every Test

lore.common: Tangles its spiral in your jumper sleeve.
lore.uncommon: Always runs out of pages one line before the end of the lesson.
lore.rare: Rips out pages so neatly that it leaves no fringe, and nobody believes it.
lore.epic: Was copied from by the whole class on the night before the exam, and the photocopier gave up.
lore.legendary: Was revised from by three brothers in a row, and all three got top marks.

names.legendary: The Pad That Remembered Everything

lore.common: Gets covered in doodles every time someone is on the phone.
lore.uncommon: Has the shopping list on it, but always stays at home on the kitchen counter.
lore.rare: Writes messages so messily that "call Gran" becomes "cool gorilla".
lore.epic: Mixed up the family's messages so badly that the plumber was invited to Sunday lunch.
lore.legendary: Wrote down a phone number that won the family a holiday, and is now kept in a frame.

names.legendary: Lady Schedula the Unstoppable

lore.common: Is coloured in with twelve different pens before a single plan is made.
lore.uncommon: Plans so many things in one day that there's no time for lunch.
lore.rare: Squeezes an extra hour into every Saturday, and the clocks are still trying to work out where it came from.
lore.epic: Planned a family holiday so tightly that they saw nine castles and no beaches.
lore.legendary: Planned a whole wedding to the minute, and the bride arrived exactly as the bells rang.

names.legendary: The Binder of Forty Subjects

lore.common: Pinches your fingers every time its rings snap shut.
lore.uncommon: Rips the holes in every sheet so the pages hang loose.
lore.rare: Grows a new coloured divider overnight, until nobody can find maths.
lore.epic: Snapped open at the bottom of the stairs and spread a whole year of coursework from the hall to the kitchen.
lore.legendary: Held every lesson from a whole school career, and the student who owned it became a teacher.

names.legendary: The Note That Ran the House

lore.common: Falls off the wall as soon as you read it.
lore.uncommon: Covers the fridge door so thickly that the fridge looks yellow.
lore.rare: Multiplies overnight, so one reminder on the fridge becomes forty by breakfast.
lore.epic: Covered every window in the office for a joke, and the boss thought it was a sunny day.
lore.legendary: Reminded a whole family to do everything for a month until the house ran itself.

names.legendary: The Bookcase That Opened a Room

lore.common: Wobbles when you take a book out from the bottom.
lore.uncommon: Sags in the middle under the heaviest books.
lore.rare: Swings open like a secret door when the right book is tilted.
lore.epic: Tipped one book over, then another, and the whole library fell like dominoes.
lore.legendary: Revealed a hidden room behind it that held a lost tea set, a cat and a very old piano.

names.legendary: The Cardboard Castle King

lore.common: Goes soggy at the corner the moment it touches a puddle.
lore.uncommon: Is turned into a fort with windows and a door by every child who finds it.
lore.rare: Becomes the fastest sledge on the hill whenever it snows.
lore.epic: Was made into a whole cardboard city in the garden, and the cat moved into the town hall.
lore.legendary: Built a castle so tall in the living room that the family ate dinner in its great hall for a week.

names.legendary: The Crane That Granted Wishes

lore.common: Comes out wonky and lopsided every time someone tries to fold it.
lore.uncommon: Flaps its paper wings when you pull its tail.
lore.rare: Grants a tiny wish to whoever folds it perfectly, or so its owner believes.
lore.epic: Was folded a thousand times by a whole school, and the string of cranes went round the playground.
lore.legendary: Was folded by a grandad for each day his granddaughter was in hospital, and she came home to a sky of them.

names.legendary: The Letter That Found Its Way

lore.common: Gives you a paper cut every time you open it in a hurry.
lore.uncommon: Has a sticky edge that tastes terrible when you lick it.
lore.rare: Has a little window that shows exactly who it's from, so you know it's a bill.
lore.epic: Arrived with five hundred others on the same birthday, and the doormat disappeared.
lore.legendary: Was posted forty years ago, lost behind a sorting machine, and arrived on the right birthday anyway.

names.legendary: The Sign That Renamed the Street

lore.common: Has been spelt wrong for thirty years, and nobody can be bothered to fix it.
lore.uncommon: Gets stickers on it every week, and the council peels them off every Monday.
lore.rare: Twists in the wind until it points down the wrong road.
lore.epic: Was turned round at the crossroads, and every delivery van in town spent the day in a cul-de-sac.
lore.legendary: Was misspelt so long that the town gave up and changed the street's name to match it.

names.legendary: The Atlas That Planned Every Holiday

lore.common: Is so heavy that it squashes your legs flat when you read it on your lap.
lore.uncommon: Has a fold-out page that never folds back the same way.
lore.rare: Opens on a random country whenever it's dropped, and its owner wants to go there.
lore.epic: Was opened on every desk in the geography lesson, and the whole class planned a trip to the same island.
lore.legendary: Planned fifty holidays for one family by falling open on the right page each summer.

names.legendary: The Map With an Extra X

lore.common: Can never be folded back the way it came out of the shop.
lore.uncommon: Is always held upside down by the person in charge.
lore.rare: Shows a path that doesn't exist, and somehow everyone finds it anyway.
lore.epic: Led a whole walking group the wrong way round a lake, and they found the best tea shop in the county.
lore.legendary: Had an X drawn on it by a grandad as a joke, and his grandchildren dug up a real tin of old coins.

names.legendary: The Paper That Printed Tomorrow

lore.common: Leaves grey ink on everyone's fingers and on the white sofa.
lore.uncommon: Gets its crossword done in pen by grandad before anyone else can try.
lore.rare: Flies off the bench on a windy day and wraps itself round a passing cyclist.
lore.epic: Blew out of every paper box in the street on the windiest Sunday, and the whole town wore headlines.
lore.legendary: Printed a story about a lost dog on Monday, and by Tuesday the dog had read it and come home.

names.legendary: The Machine That Stitched a Town

lore.common: Snarls its thread into a bird's nest under the fabric.
lore.uncommon: Is driven by a foot pedal that its owner presses like a racing car.
lore.rare: Stitched a hem so fast that the curtain was finished before the kettle boiled.
lore.epic: Made every costume for the school play in one week, including a dragon and a talking teapot.
lore.legendary: Stitched a patchwork quilt so big that it covered the whole village green for the summer fair.

names.legendary: The Puncher That Made It Snow

lore.common: Spills its little paper circles all over the floor when you open it.
lore.uncommon: Jams if you put more than three sheets in it.
lore.rare: Punches holes slightly off-centre, so every page hangs crooked.
lore.epic: Was emptied out of the office window for a joke, and the car park looked like it had snowed.
lore.legendary: Punched enough paper circles for a whole wedding's confetti, and saved the bride buying any.

names.legendary: Sir Labelworth the Thorough

lore.common: Labels the light switch, the door and the dog's bowl.
lore.uncommon: Prints every label with a typo, so the jar says SUGRA.
lore.rare: Sticks its label so firmly that it never comes off, even in the dishwasher.
lore.epic: Labelled everything in the kitchen in one afternoon, including the kettle, the toaster and Dad.
lore.legendary: Labelled every shelf in the giant library so well that a lost book was found after fifty years.

names.legendary: The Jaws of the Office

lore.common: Snaps its little jaws like a crocodile on your fingers.
lore.uncommon: Pinches the paper and tears a corner off along with the staple.
lore.rare: Rescues pages from staples so neatly that the holes vanish.
lore.epic: Freed every page from a mountain of stapled reports, and the office looked like a paper snowstorm.
lore.legendary: Unstapled a thousand reports in one afternoon and was given a little crown made of staples.

names.legendary: The Tape Gun That Taped the Van

lore.common: Screeches so loudly when it's pulled that everyone covers their ears.
lore.uncommon: Seals a box in one long noisy swoop.
lore.rare: Finds the end of the tape every time, which no human can do.
lore.epic: Sealed every box on moving day so well that nobody could open them for a week.
lore.legendary: Taped a whole van shut by mistake, with the moving men still inside eating sandwiches.

names.legendary: The Note That Came Back

lore.common: Gets folded and refolded so many times that the face on it looks like it's winking.
lore.uncommon: Gets folded so small that it disappears in the wallet.
lore.rare: Turns up in old coat pockets just when someone needs it most.
lore.epic: Blew down the high street on a windy day, and twenty people chased it.
lore.legendary: Was spent at the market, travelled the country for ten years, and came back to its owner in change.

names.legendary: The Banner That Lifted Off

lore.common: Sags in the middle so the words read WELC... OME.
lore.uncommon: Fills with wind like a sail and tries to fly away.
lore.rare: Flapped its welcome message so loudly that the guests arrived early.
lore.epic: Was hung across the whole street for the party, and every lorry had to drive under it on tiptoe.
lore.legendary: Was blown away in a gale and landed across the finish line of a marathon, just in time.

names.legendary: The Great Family Book

lore.common: Has pages so thin that they stick together and tear if you rush.
lore.uncommon: Is so heavy that it needs two hands and a table.
lore.rare: Has every family birthday from a hundred years ago written in the front cover.
lore.epic: Fell off the top shelf during spring cleaning and shook every ornament in the room.
lore.legendary: Held the names of seven generations in its front pages, and the newest baby was added this year.

names.legendary: The Clip That Held the Office Together

lore.common: Snaps shut on your thumb when you squeeze its little wings.
lore.uncommon: Flips its silver wings down flat so they poke out like rabbit ears.
lore.rare: Grips a stack of paper so tightly that the pages fuse into a block.
lore.epic: Clipped every report in the office together, and the whole building's work ended up in one giant bundle.
lore.legendary: Held up a falling bookshelf, a broken curtain and a loose hem in the same day.

names.legendary: The Card That Sang for Ten Years

lore.common: Gets shaken upside down by every child to see if money falls out.
lore.uncommon: Plays a tinny tune when opened that nobody can switch off.
lore.rare: Sheds so much glitter that the whole house sparkles until Easter.
lore.epic: Fell off the mantelpiece and knocked down every other card in a long paper domino.
lore.legendary: Sang its tune every time it was opened for ten years, until the whole family could hum it in their sleep.

names.legendary: The Stand That Turned the Pages

lore.common: Lets its book flop shut just as you find your place.
lore.uncommon: Holds the cookbook open while flour gets on every page.
lore.rare: Snaps the pages back with a clip that pinches fingers.
lore.epic: Held open every recipe at the bake sale, and the stand was coated in icing.
lore.legendary: Held a book open for a reader who fell asleep, and kept the place for three days.

names.legendary: The Bookend Who Held a Library

lore.common: Slides along the shelf until the books fall over anyway.
lore.uncommon: Is a heavy little elephant that stubs everyone's toe when it falls.
lore.rare: Pushes the books so tight that nobody can get one out.
lore.epic: Slid off the end of the shelf, and every book in the row followed it to the floor.
lore.legendary: Held up a whole wall of books for fifty years, and the library named a shelf after it.

names.legendary: The Booklet That Explained Everything

lore.common: Stabs your finger with its staple every time you open it.
lore.uncommon: Curls up at the corners so it never lies flat.
lore.rare: Has instructions that make perfect sense only after you've finished.
lore.epic: Guided a whole family through building a wardrobe, and they used every screw except three.
lore.legendary: Explained a robot kit so clearly that a seven-year-old built it in one afternoon.

names.legendary: The Bookmark That Waited a Hundred Years

lore.common: Slips out of the book the moment someone shakes it.
lore.uncommon: Saves your page, but in the wrong book.
lore.rare: Swings its little tassel so that it tickles your nose while you read.
lore.epic: Fell out of every library book on the trolley, and three hundred readers lost their place.
lore.legendary: Was found in an old library book where a reader had left it a hundred years before, still on the same page.

names.legendary: The Brochure That Booked the Trip

lore.common: Lands on the doormat every morning, folded three times.
lore.uncommon: Has glossy pages so shiny that you can see your face in them.
lore.rare: Shows a beach so blue that everyone who reads it wants to leave immediately.
lore.epic: Was read by everyone at the bus stop, and the whole queue booked the same holiday.
lore.legendary: Made a family save up for twenty years, and they finally went to the island on its cover.

names.legendary: The Canvas That Painted Itself

lore.common: Stares back blankly until the painter gives up and makes a cup of tea.
lore.uncommon: Soaks up paint so fast that you need three coats for one colour.
lore.rare: Turns every spill into something that looks like it was meant to be there.
lore.epic: Was splattered by a whole art class in one afternoon, and it won the school art prize.
lore.legendary: Was left out in a storm and came back with a painting nobody had touched.

names.legendary: The Print That Fooled the Gallery

lore.common: Hangs crooked no matter how many times it's straightened.
lore.uncommon: Is a copy of a famous painting that everyone says looks very real.
lore.rare: Fooled a visitor into thinking it was the original for a whole afternoon.
lore.epic: Was hung all the way up the staircase, and visitors stopped on every step.
lore.legendary: Was hung in the hall so convincingly that an art expert asked to borrow it.

names.legendary: The Chalk That Drew a Whole Town

lore.common: Squeaks on the board so that everyone's teeth tingle.
lore.uncommon: Leaves white dust on your fingers, your sleeve and your nose.
lore.rare: Draws pictures on the pavement so real that people step round them.
lore.epic: Covered the whole playground with hopscotch and drawings, and the rain had a busy night.
lore.legendary: Drew a whole town on the pavement, and the postman tried to deliver a letter to one of the houses.

names.legendary: Old Slate, Teacher of Thousands

lore.common: Screeches when someone drags their nails down it.
lore.uncommon: Is covered in a thin layer of white dust that never quite goes away.
lore.rare: Keeps yesterday's answers faintly visible underneath today's sums.
lore.epic: Was wiped so hard at the end of term that the whole classroom filled with chalk dust.
lore.legendary: Taught every child in a village for a hundred years, and still has a sum on it from the first lesson.

names.legendary: The Smelliest Stick in Town

lore.common: Makes the whole car smell for weeks after one drive.
lore.uncommon: Ends up in the ashtray, which nobody ever wants to empty.
lore.rare: Makes everyone nearby cough and wave their hands.
lore.epic: Left such a smell in the café that every customer moved outside to the terrace.
lore.legendary: Was thrown in the bin for good by a grandad who decided he'd rather go walking with his grandchildren.

names.legendary: The Last Butt in the Bin

lore.common: Gets dropped on the pavement by people who should know better.
lore.uncommon: Hides in the gutter and blocks the drain with its friends.
lore.rare: Spoils the sand on the beach and takes years to disappear.
lore.epic: Was picked up by every volunteer on beach clean-up day, and the bin was full by lunch.
lore.legendary: Was the very last one picked up on the cleanest beach in the country, and was put in the bin with a cheer.

names.legendary: The Comic That Started a Superhero

lore.common: Gets its pages turned so fast that nobody reads the words.
lore.uncommon: Has speech bubbles that everyone reads out in silly voices.
lore.rare: Makes its reader shout KAPOW out loud on the quiet train without noticing.
lore.epic: Started a comic swap at school that went round every class in a week.
lore.legendary: Inspired its reader to draw her own comic, which is now sold in every shop.

names.legendary: The Cookbook That Saved the Feast

lore.common: Has pages stuck together with flour and egg.
lore.uncommon: Has a chocolate stain on its favourite recipe, which proves it's good.
lore.rare: Skips a step in every recipe, so the cake always comes out flat.
lore.epic: Followed one recipe so badly that the kitchen ceiling got a pancake stuck to it.
lore.legendary: Saved a holiday dinner when the oven broke, with a recipe for a cake made in a frying pan.

names.legendary: Sir Plastic of the Wallet

lore.common: Gets declined at the till just when a queue has formed.
lore.uncommon: Gets lost in the wallet behind library cards and loyalty cards.
lore.rare: Taps for everything so easily that its owner forgets how much they've spent.
lore.epic: Bought the whole family's holiday in one tap, and then a very big ice cream.
lore.legendary: Was used to pick a lock when the family got stuck outside their own front door.

names.legendary: The Hook That Made a Village Blanket

lore.common: Drops its loop just as the row was nearly finished.
lore.uncommon: Makes little granny squares one after another.
lore.rare: Whirls so fast that its owner made a scarf on one bus ride.
lore.epic: Made a blanket so big over one weekend that it covered the whole sofa and the cat.
lore.legendary: Made a blanket so long that it wrapped round every tree in the village square.

names.legendary: The Book That Knew Every Word

lore.common: Is so heavy that it's mostly used as a doorstop.
lore.uncommon: Hides the word you want three pages away from where you'd think.
lore.rare: Settles every family argument about spelling, then starts a new one.
lore.epic: Was read by the whole class before the spelling bee, and the school won the final.
lore.legendary: Knew every word in the language and still found room for a new one this year.

names.legendary: The Easel That Stood in Every Weather

lore.common: Collapses its legs every time someone bumps the table, with the wet painting still on it.
lore.uncommon: Pinches the painter's fingers when the clamp is tightened.
lore.rare: Folds itself up in the wind and takes the canvas with it.
lore.epic: Stood with fifty others in the park for painting day, and the whole park looked like a gallery.
lore.legendary: Stood on the same clifftop through every season while a painter painted the same view a thousand times.

names.legendary: The Twenty-Four Volume Know-It-All

lore.common: Takes up a whole shelf with its twenty volumes.
lore.uncommon: Has a dusty spine that nobody has opened for years.
lore.rare: Answers every question, but only after you've found the right volume.
lore.epic: Saved every pupil's homework the night the internet went down.
lore.legendary: Knew so much that a quiz champion read every volume and never lost a game.

names.legendary: The Flag That Started the Race

lore.common: Tangles round its pole every time the wind changes.
lore.uncommon: Is waved so hard at the match that its stick snaps in half by the second goal.
lore.rare: Marks the finish line so clearly that nobody can argue who won.
lore.epic: Was waved at sports day by every family, and the whole field fluttered.
lore.legendary: Started a thousand races at the same school and only got tangled once.

names.legendary: The Flyer That Found Mittens

lore.common: Gets stuck under the car's windscreen wiper and flaps all the way to work.
lore.uncommon: Gets stuffed through the letterbox so often that the doormat is covered.
lore.rare: Gets pinned to every noticeboard in town before anyone notices.
lore.epic: Was pinned to every lamp post in the street, and the whole neighbourhood went looking for the lost cat.
lore.legendary: Found a lost cat called Mittens after a week, and was framed by the happy family.

names.legendary: The Stick That Stuck the Art Show

lore.common: Loses its cap and dries out by the next lesson.
lore.uncommon: Twists up too far so the glue snaps off.
lore.rare: Sticks fingers together better than it sticks paper.
lore.epic: Stuck every picture on the school display board in one afternoon, and nothing fell off for a year.
lore.legendary: Glued together a whole collage of the town that now hangs in the town hall.

names.legendary: The Card Signed by the Whole Town

lore.common: Is always bought at the last minute from the petrol station.
lore.uncommon: Gets signed by everyone in the office who has never met the person.
lore.rare: Pops up a paper castle when you open it that never folds back down.
lore.epic: Was passed round the whole office and came back with signatures on the back, the envelope and the stamp.
lore.legendary: Was signed by everyone in the town for a retiring postman, and he cried at the bus stop.

names.legendary: The Clip That Held a Hairdo All Day

lore.common: Snaps open and falls out halfway through the morning.
lore.uncommon: Pinches the fringe so tightly that it leaves a dent.
lore.rare: Grabs a whole head of hair in one claw, like a crab.
lore.epic: Held every ponytail in the house together on the busiest school morning.
lore.legendary: Held up a bride's hair through a whole wedding, the dancing and the fireworks.

names.legendary: The Hair Tie That Was Never Lost

lore.common: Lives on your wrist until it leaves a red mark.
lore.uncommon: Snaps at the worst moment, usually during a race.
lore.rare: Vanishes from every drawer, bag and pocket the moment it's needed.
lore.epic: Tied up every ponytail on the netball team, and the whole team played better.
lore.legendary: Was never lost once in ten years, which no other hair tie in history has managed.

names.legendary: The Pin That Held a Ballerina's Bun

lore.common: Hides in the carpet and stabs bare feet.
lore.uncommon: Holds a bun together with fifty of its friends.
lore.rare: Picked a lock in an emergency, just like in the films.
lore.epic: Held every dancer's bun in the ballet show without a single strand falling.
lore.legendary: Held up a ballerina's bun through a whole season, and she gave it a little box of its own.

names.legendary: The Hoop That Spun All Summer

lore.common: Drops to the ground after two turns no matter how hard you wiggle.
lore.uncommon: Spins round your arm instead of your waist.
lore.rare: Twirled round its owner's waist for an hour without stopping.
lore.epic: Started a hoop craze that spun through every playground in town.
lore.legendary: Was spun for a whole summer by the same child and never once dropped.

names.legendary: The Card That Knew Every Door

lore.common: Has the worst photo of its owner ever taken, and everyone sees it.
lore.uncommon: Twists round on its lanyard so it always shows the back.
lore.rare: Makes every security guard nod you through, even on your worst hair day.
lore.epic: Was left at home by the whole team on the same Monday, and the office had to be opened with a chair.
lore.legendary: Opened a door that had been locked for fifty years, and behind it was the office's old tea trolley.

names.legendary: The Stick That Scented a Street

lore.common: Drops a little grey worm of ash on the table that crumbles when you touch it.
lore.uncommon: Curls its smoke into twisty shapes that float up to the ceiling.
lore.rare: Makes everyone in the room sneeze three times, one after the other.
lore.epic: Was burned in the gift shop doorway, and the whole street smelled of flowers until bedtime.
lore.legendary: Scented a whole market street so sweetly that the bakery complained nobody could smell its bread.

names.legendary: Granny Clickety, Queen of Wool

lore.common: Clicks so loudly in front of the TV that nobody can hear the news.
lore.uncommon: Drops a stitch every ten rows and leaves a little hole.
lore.rare: Knits so fast that a scarf grows a foot long during one bus journey.
lore.epic: Clicked away with the whole knitting circle until the village hall was full of jumpers.
lore.legendary: Knitted a jumper for every child in the village before the first snow.

names.legendary: Sir Plasticoat the Everlasting

lore.common: Leaves a bubble in the middle of every sheet it seals.
lore.uncommon: Takes ten minutes to warm up before it'll do anything.
lore.rare: Seals paper so tightly that it becomes waterproof forever.
lore.epic: Laminated every sign in the school, including the one that said Do Not Laminate.
lore.legendary: Laminated a child's drawing so well that it survived a flood, a dog and thirty years in a drawer.

names.legendary: The Dot That No Cat Ever Caught

lore.common: Makes the cat chase a red dot up the curtains.
lore.uncommon: Wobbles its little dot all over the screen during a talk.
lore.rare: Points out stars in the night sky so clearly that everyone sees the right one.
lore.epic: Sent every cat in the house chasing the dot round the living room, and the vase didn't make it.
lore.legendary: Has been chased by the same cat for ten years, and the cat is still sure it will win.

names.legendary: The Leaflet That Got Read

lore.common: Lands on the doormat in a pile every morning.
lore.uncommon: Falls out of every magazine you open.
lore.rare: Gets recycled before anyone reads a word of it.
lore.epic: Blew out of a delivery bag and covered the whole street like a paper snowstorm.
lore.legendary: Was finally read by one person, who came to the event and won the tombola.

names.legendary: The Letter That Crossed the Ocean

lore.common: Makes every line of handwriting slope downhill.
lore.uncommon: Soaks up ink so fast that every full stop becomes a blob.
lore.rare: Holds words so heartfelt that its reader keeps it in a pocket for years.
lore.epic: Was used by a whole class to write to pen pals, and the post office ran out of stamps.
lore.legendary: Was written on by one pen pal for fifty years, and the two friends finally met at the airport.

names.legendary: The Level That Straightened a Town

lore.common: Has a bubble that never quite sits in the middle.
lore.uncommon: Checks every shelf, then tells you it's wonky after you've drilled the holes.
lore.rare: Finds every crooked thing in the house, including the cat lying on the sofa.
lore.epic: Straightened every picture in the house in one afternoon, and the house looked brand new.
lore.legendary: Straightened every sign in the whole town, and the crooked clock tower too.

names.legendary: The Stack Taller Than Dad

lore.common: Topples over every time someone takes one from the middle.
lore.uncommon: Has the same old magazine on top for six months.
lore.rare: Grows a new magazine every week, until it's taller than the coffee table.
lore.epic: Slid across the whole waiting room floor, and everyone helped tidy it up.
lore.legendary: Grew so tall in the dentist's waiting room that it had to be measured, and was taller than the dentist.

names.legendary: The Volume That Ended Everything

lore.common: Is read from back to front, so everyone starts at the ending.
lore.uncommon: Ends every volume on a cliffhanger that makes you scream.
lore.rare: Gets read in one night, then the reader stays up waiting for the next one.
lore.epic: Had a queue round the bookshop on release day, and the shop ran out by lunch.
lore.legendary: Finished a story that ran for twenty years, and readers all over the world cried on the same day.

names.legendary: The Menu That Fed a Village

lore.common: Has a sticky cover from every spilled drink.
lore.uncommon: Has a list of specials that changes the moment you choose one.
lore.rare: Has so many choices that the whole table takes half an hour to order.
lore.epic: Got everyone at the wedding dinner ordering the same dish, and the kitchen ran out in minutes.
lore.legendary: Has fed a whole village every Sunday for fifty years without changing a single dish.

names.legendary: The Stack That Held the Garage Up

lore.common: Piles up by the back door waiting to be recycled.
lore.uncommon: Leaves grey ink on everything it touches.
lore.rare: Is used to light every fire and still never seems to get smaller.
lore.epic: Grew so big in the garage that the car had to park outside.
lore.legendary: Was found to hold every edition from fifty years, and the town museum took it away in a lorry.

names.legendary: The Folder of a Thousand Creatures

lore.common: Comes out lopsided after forty folds and looks like a crumpled napkin.
lore.uncommon: Is folded into a frog that hops when you press its back.
lore.rare: Folds itself into a new animal every time someone looks away.
lore.epic: Filled the classroom with paper animals in one lesson, and the teacher couldn't find her desk.
lore.legendary: Folded a whole zoo from one long sheet of paper without a single cut.

names.legendary: The Tube That Painted a Rainbow

lore.common: Squeezes out far too much paint, so it gets on everything.
lore.uncommon: Has its cap glued shut with dried paint.
lore.rare: Bursts with colour so bright that the whole painting changes.
lore.epic: Was squeezed out by the whole art class at once, and the art room floor became a rainbow.
lore.legendary: Painted the brightest rainbow ever seen on the school wall, and it is still there.

names.legendary: The Painting That Winked

lore.common: Has eyes that seem to follow you round the room.
lore.uncommon: Hangs slightly crooked, and someone always straightens it.
lore.rare: Stops visitors in their tracks for so long that the gallery has a queue behind them.
lore.epic: Made the whole gallery gasp at once on opening night.
lore.legendary: Was found in an attic, cleaned up, and turned out to be the most famous painting nobody had ever seen.

names.legendary: The Pamphlet That Saved the Park

lore.common: Has a staple that comes undone on the second page.
lore.uncommon: Gets wet in the rain and drips ink on your hands.
lore.rare: Persuades whoever reads it to go to a meeting they'd never heard of.
lore.epic: Was handed to every person at the market, and the town hall was full that evening.
lore.legendary: Persuaded a whole town to save the old park, and the park still has a bench in its honour.

names.legendary: The Clip That Traded Up to a House

lore.common: Gets bent out of shape by every nervous person in a meeting.
lore.uncommon: Links into chains so long that they reach across the classroom.
lore.rare: Picks every simple lock, even the diary's.
lore.epic: Was linked into a chain long enough to go round the whole school.
lore.legendary: Was traded for a pen, then a book, then a bike, and ended up as a garden shed.

names.legendary: The Plane That Flew Across the Hall

lore.common: Nosedives straight into the floor every time it's thrown.
lore.uncommon: Loops the loop and lands on the teacher's desk.
lore.rare: Glides so far down the corridor that it reaches the head's office.
lore.epic: Was thrown by every child in the playground at once, and the sky was full of paper.
lore.legendary: Flew the full length of the school hall during assembly, and the whole school clapped.

names.legendary: The Sheet That Became Everything

lore.common: Gives you a paper cut that hurts more than anything bigger.
lore.uncommon: Stays completely blank while you stare at it for an hour.
lore.rare: Flies off the desk in the faintest breeze and hides under the fridge.
lore.epic: Was blown off every desk in the office when the window opened, and everyone was ankle-deep in paper.
lore.legendary: Became a letter, a plane, a hat and a boat on the same afternoon.

names.legendary: The Ream That Printed a Novel

lore.common: Feeds into the printer five sheets at a time.
lore.uncommon: Is so heavy in its ream that it hurts to carry.
lore.rare: Fans out with a satisfying flutter when you flick its edge.
lore.epic: Was knocked off the printer table, and the whole office spent lunch gathering it.
lore.legendary: Printed every page of a famous novel in one go, and the writer kept it on her desk.

names.legendary: The Album of a Hundred Birthdays

lore.common: Has sticky plastic pages that make a crackling noise.
lore.uncommon: Has photos that fade a little more every year.
lore.rare: Makes everyone stop and look at old haircuts for an hour.
lore.epic: Was opened at the family reunion, and everybody laughed at the same baby photo.
lore.legendary: Holds a photo from every birthday for a hundred years in one family.

names.legendary: The Frame That Held the Best Smile

lore.common: Falls face down on the mantelpiece every time a door slams.
lore.uncommon: Collects dust on its glass so the photo looks foggy.
lore.rare: Holds a smile so big that everyone who sees it smiles too.
lore.epic: Was crowded onto the mantelpiece with fifty others, and one sneeze knocked them all over.
lore.legendary: Held the same family photo for fifty years, and four generations are now standing in it.

names.legendary: The Book Read a Thousand Times

lore.common: Gets its pages ripped by a toddler in a hurry to see the next picture.
lore.uncommon: Is asked for again and again, every single night.
lore.rare: Makes the grown-up reading it yawn halfway through.
lore.epic: Was read so many times at bedtime that the whole family could recite it with their eyes shut.
lore.legendary: Was read a thousand times to one child, who grew up to write their own picture books.

names.legendary: Grand Frameworth of the Staircase

lore.common: Leaves a nail hole in the wall every time it's moved.
lore.uncommon: Reflects the window so you can't see the picture inside.
lore.rare: Makes even the simplest drawing look like it's in a museum.
lore.epic: Fell off its hook during the party, and a domino line of frames went down the whole hallway.
lore.legendary: Turned a child's crayon drawing into the most admired picture at the art show.

names.legendary: The Cushion That Held a Thousand Pins

lore.common: Bristles with so many pins that it looks like a hedgehog.
lore.uncommon: Is shaped like a little tomato, and guests keep trying to put it in the salad.
lore.rare: Pokes a pin into whoever sits on it by mistake.
lore.epic: Held every pin at the sewing bee, and nobody lost a single one.
lore.legendary: Held the pins for a hundred wedding dresses and never pricked the bride.

names.legendary: The Ace That Always Turned Up

lore.common: Loses the joker from every pack within a week.
lore.uncommon: Gets a bent corner so everyone knows which card it is.
lore.rare: Slips up a magician's sleeve and appears in the wrong pocket.
lore.epic: Was built into a card house taller than the table, until someone sneezed.
lore.legendary: Turned up in every hand of cards for a whole holiday, and the family started calling it lucky.

names.legendary: The Book That Built a Castle

lore.common: Gets its pull tabs torn off by eager little hands.
lore.uncommon: Pops a dragon out so suddenly that it slaps your nose.
lore.rare: Builds a whole paper castle when opened, then won't fold back properly.
lore.epic: Was opened in the middle of the classroom, and the whole class gasped at the paper theatre.
lore.legendary: Built a castle so detailed that an architect studied it to design a real one.

names.legendary: The Postcards From Every Country

lore.common: Piles up on the fridge until the door won't close.
lore.uncommon: Says wish you were here on every single one.
lore.rare: Has a stamp from a country nobody in the family has ever been to.
lore.epic: Covered the whole fridge, and then the kitchen wall, and then the ceiling.
lore.legendary: Has one postcard from every country in the world, sent by the same aunt over forty years.
